en.name: Inspiratory pressure setting (Pinsp)
en.shortDescription: Set inspiratory pressure on the ventilator (pressure-controlled breaths), in cmH2O; a setting, not a measured pressure.
en.longDescription:
## Definition & Clinical Context

The inspiratory pressure setting is the airway pressure the clinician sets on the ventilator to deliver each breath in a pressure-controlled mode — the target pressure the ventilator applies during inspiration. In source data it is a single numeric value per patient-timestamp, a ventilator setting rather than a measured airway pressure. It is recorded in intensive care and anaesthesia for ventilated patients. It is reported in centimetres of water (**cmH2O**); some ventilators display it in millibar (mbar), which is nearly equivalent (1 cmH2O ≈ 0.98 mbar).

## Included Concepts

This set contains the single SNOMED concept for the inspiratory pressure setting:

- *4215838 / 417071008 — Inspiratory pressure setting (SNOMED)*: the set inspiratory pressure on the ventilator.

**Note on units**: reported in **`44777590 / cm[H2O] — centimeter watercolumn`** (UCUM), the recommended unit; a cmH2O↔mbar conversion is registered (1 cmH2O = 0.98 mbar).

## Mapping Notes

- Map the set inspiratory pressure on a pressure-controlled ventilator to *4215838 / 417071008 — Inspiratory pressure setting*.
- **Setting, not a measured pressure**: this is the *set* target pressure, distinct from measured airway pressures. Peak inspiratory pressure, plateau pressure, mean airway pressure and PEEP are measured/derived pressures captured in their own concept sets.
- **Whether this is the pressure above PEEP or the absolute inspiratory pressure depends on the ventilator** and is not distinguished by this concept; preserve any such detail in the source value if needed, but map the value here regardless.
- **Pressure support level** (the inspiratory assist set in a spontaneous/support mode) is a distinct ventilator setting and is not part of this concept set.

reviews.comments:
## Summary
**Approved.** Added to project 5 in [PR #4](https://github.com/indicate-eu/data-dictionary/pull/4). Used in QI01 as the fallback code for plateau pressure (4215838) in pressure-driven modes.

## Use in our quality indicators
- Used in QI01 (Lung-protective ventilation in ARDS).
- CQL: all 1 concept(s) of the set are referenced in [`IndicateQi01Ventilation.cql`](https://github.com/umg-minai/cql-indicate-qi/blob/d63eb84a308d5586fcede0b7e3fa73abf6b6761c/cql/IndicateQi01Ventilation.cql?plain=1) ([4215838](https://github.com/umg-minai/cql-indicate-qi/blob/d63eb84a308d5586fcede0b7e3fa73abf6b6761c/cql/IndicateQi01Ventilation.cql?plain=1#L71); each ID links to its code definition).

## Decision trail
- 2026-01-12 · Sebastian Gibb (clinician): Priority information added to the QI01 mapping ([PEEP: 42527140 total measured > 4216746 setting > 4353713 generic](https://github.com/umg-minai/indicate-qi-definitions/blob/8014d1e86ebee84856c8163ac1f98e54061cd24b/qi01-ventilation.md?plain=1#L192); [Vt: 44782826 inspiratory > 4108448 spontaneous > 3012410 setting > 4029625 generic](https://github.com/umg-minai/indicate-qi-definitions/blob/8014d1e86ebee84856c8163ac1f98e54061cd24b/qi01-ventilation.md?plain=1#L198); [Pinsp 4215838 before PIP 4101694](https://github.com/umg-minai/indicate-qi-definitions/blob/8014d1e86ebee84856c8163ac1f98e54061cd24b/qi01-ventilation.md?plain=1#L196); rule in the [mapping notes](https://github.com/umg-minai/indicate-qi-definitions/blob/8014d1e86ebee84856c8163ac1f98e54061cd24b/qi01-ventilation.md?plain=1#L169)). — [QI commit 26ca861](https://github.com/umg-minai/indicate-qi-definitions/commit/26ca861af085ba7c1f0d7f30ca2302eb417de259)
- 2026-02-11 · Jan Moringen (implementation): Inspiratory-pressure fallback implemented with the codes 4215838 (Pinsp) and 4101694 (PIP, mmHg→cmH2O). — [CQL commit 479c102](https://github.com/umg-minai/cql-indicate-qi/commit/479c102447d5851deaababa68ca1df55e955fbcc)
- 2026-03-23 · Gregor Lichtner (interoperability): CS 299 (Endotracheal tube) and CS 314 (Inspiratory pressure setting) added to project 5; new sets 339/340 (PCV/VCV) created from the CS 306 procedure codes. — [DD PR #4 (merged by Boris Delange 2026-04-01)](https://github.com/indicate-eu/data-dictionary/pull/4)
- 2026-03-23 · Jan Moringen (implementation) → Gregor Lichtner (interoperability): Ventilation mode read from the procedure codes of CS 306, classified as pressure- or volume-driven in [ventilation-modes.md](https://github.com/umg-minai/indicate-qi-definitions/blob/8014d1e86ebee84856c8163ac1f98e54061cd24b/ventilation-modes.md?plain=1) (4 codes "unclear"); the plateau-pressure fallback uses 4215838 ([QI01 § Plateau pressure](https://github.com/umg-minai/indicate-qi-definitions/blob/8014d1e86ebee84856c8163ac1f98e54061cd24b/qi01-ventilation.md?plain=1#L146)). — [QI issue #4 → PR #5 (commits e696f07, 0c3e0e2)](https://github.com/umg-minai/indicate-qi-definitions/issues/4#issuecomment-4119312833)

## Suggestions
- None.
